topic: David Rosenhan & Bill Underwood (1973) Stanford Pseudopatient Ward Study, Six-Minute Staff Contact, Zero-Impostor Teaching Hospital Challenge, Spitzer Checklist Reform, and 2019 Archive Audit (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Robert Spitzer's diagnostic checklist reform paired with the archival discovery inside Rosenhan's locked study files confirming Bill Underwood's authentic nine-day ward chart while exposing an omitted volunteer and edited intake notes.
